documents.subject: Payroll record and settlement-policy clarification
documents.body:
Hello Casey Team05,

For the 2026-06-30 payroll record, PAY-018 lists gross payroll of $438,000.00, withholding of $87,600.00, employer costs of $35,040.00, and net payroll of $350,400.00. documents.subject: Settlement treatment excerpt
documents.body:
Draft service excerpt, effective for review on 2026-06-30:

“Under company identifier MERIDIAN-001, settlement treatment is limited to confirmed external movements. A proposal, request, or other unconfirmed item must not be treated as a settlement solely because it appears in a workflow or reconciliation record. The parties should request missing explanations and supporting status details where necessary. This excerpt does not specify additional commercial terms, approvals, payments, or transaction purpose, and no unresolved item is deemed settled by inclusion in this draft.”
